messages:
samir: FYI discovered a new OpenSSL CVE (CVE-2026-XXXX) flagged by vendor scan, looks like a TLS1.2 handshake parsing issue that can be triggered on some long-lived mTLS connections. impact: potential handshake failures + DoS on edge proxies in APAC region
rachael: ack. which images/runtimes are using the vulnerable OpenSSL?
samir: runtime builds on ubuntu-22.04 and our envoy-based sidecars on x86-64. initial grep shows affected openssl version: 3.1.2. pinned on some older dedicated nodes. not all regions.
cheng: can we mitigate with config first (force TLS1.3 + remove old ciphers) while we plan a rebuild?
karim: +1. rolling TLS hardening is the fastest mitigation. need to check inter-service mTLS compatibility for legacy clients (mobile SDKs, some partner feds).
samir: proposed immediate mitigations:
- enforce TLS 1.3 on ingress/egress proxies (envoy/nginx)
- disable TLS1.0/1.1/1.2 ciphers in config
- block long-lived handshake patterns via timeout tuning
- schedule cert rotation only after runtime rebuild
cheng: example envoy config snippet to apply via helm values (canary to eu-west-1 first):
```yaml
transport_socket:
  tls_context:
    common_tls_context:
      tls_params:
        tls_minimum_protocol_version: TLSv1_3
        cipher_suites:
          - TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
          - TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384
```
rachael: good. also need to update RBAC so the regional service roles can read keys from KMS for cert operations. current role lacks kms:Decrypt on replica key in ap-southeast-1.
karim: I'm on RBAC. proposed policy change (IAM):
```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:123456789012:key/replica-key-id"
}
```
samir: note: prefer least-privilege: add condition to limit to service principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/service-region-redwood
security-sre: audit note — any KMS RBAC change must be accompanied by audit-log pipeline subscription so all Decrypt/GenerateDataKey events are forwarded to splunk-infra for 90 days. also need alert rule on cross-region key usage spikes.
rachael: agree. add to PR checklist: update cloudtrail -> kinesis -> splunk mapping for the key ARN, and create sig-alert for abnormal calls.
karim: on cert management: are we storing private keys in KMS or in Vault? current plan: CMKs wrap the envelope key, private material stored in Vault. we should confirm replication behavior for Vault snapshots across regions.
cheng: Vault has DR replication but our current config uses manual snapshot replication for apac. ops: we should switch to integrated replication and enable auto-unseal with regional KMS CMKs.
samir: action items:
1) cheng to prepare envoy/nginx helm patch to enforce TLS1.3 + cipher list, canary to eu-west-1 (due EOD)
2) karim to open RBAC PR for kms:Decrypt on regional service roles + least-priv condition (ETA 4h)
3) rachael to update audit pipeline and create splunk saved search/alert (ETA tomorrow morning)
4) security-sre to add incident playbook entry for this CVE and run vuln-triage (assign remediation severity)
5) samir to coordinate runtime rebuilds for dedicated nodes and schedule blue/green deploys (hold cert rotation until rebuild validated)

deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout to eu-west-1 for envoy config at 2026-06-02T15:10Z (job id: roll-1791234567-canary)
karim: note for smoke tests: use openssl s_client to validate handshake and check ALPN. sample command:
```
openssl s_client -connect proxy.eu-west-1.redwood.internal:443 -servername service-a.redwood.internal -alpn h2 -tls1_3
```
cheng: also add a short script to validate mTLS client certs and key unwrap via KMS:
```bash
# test unwrap via kms
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://wrapped_key.bin --region ap-southeast-1 --profile infra-test
```
security-sre: triage notes: probable severity: HIGH (affects handshake parsing, causes DoS). recommended post-mitigations: backport runtime patch + rotate any certificates older than 90 days as precaution.
rachael: one more ask — ensure our canary uses service account with new RBAC only; do not grant org-wide decrypt. also add a CloudWatch metric for TLS handshake failures per region (we currently only track 5xx).
samir: thanks all. I'll kick off a short incident channel if we see the canary fail. keep thread updated with PR links / deploy job ids.
karim: opened PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/478 (adds RBAC condition + test).
cheng: helm patch -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/312 (envoy tls_min changes). canary logs look clean so far, 10/10 successful handshakes in eu-west-1 smoke run.
security-sre: attaching incident playbook stub to the ticket in JIRA: INFSEC-1229. will run tabletop tomorrow to validate runbook.
samir: closing loop — if anyone sees unexpected client failures, ping #eng-oncall and @carol (oncall). otherwise we proceed with staged rollout and runtime rebuild schedule next week.
